items.source: %d spiderbots are protecting you, each with %d life. Current top spiderbot has %d life remaining.
items.target: %d 个蜘蛛机器人正在保护你，每个具有 %d 生命值。目前顶上的蜘蛛机器人还有 %d 生命值。

items.source: The target is covered in burning chemicals, taking %0.2f fire damage each turn. Subsequent shots deal %0.2f fire damage, and if they fall below 25%% life they have a %d%% chance to panic.
items.target: 目标被燃烧的化学物质所覆盖，每回合受到 %0.2f 火焰伤害。之后的射击将会造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害，若目标降低到 25%% 生命值以下，他们有 %d%% 的几率慌乱逃跑。

items.source: Resisting pain, reducing all incoming damage by %0.2f. When the effect ends, take %d un-resistable damage.
items.target: 抵抗疼痛，受到的伤害减少 %0.2f。效果结束后受到 %d 点无法抵抗的伤害。

items.source: The target is burning for %d fire damage each turn and taking %d%% increased damage from all sources.
items.target: 目标被点燃，每回合受到 %d 火焰伤害，所受到的所有伤害增加 %d%%。

items.source: The target is grappled by %s, pinning them, reducing attack, spell and mind speed by %d%% and subjecting them to an automatic tailsaw strike each turn for %d%% damage.
items.target: 目标被 %s 抓取，被定身，降低战斗、法术和精神速度 %d%%，并每回合受到一次自动的尾部链锯打击，造成 %d%% 伤害。

items.source: Bullets shot are supercharged:  They can pass through multiple targets and have %d additional armour penetration.
items.target: 子弹处于超速状态：能够穿透多个目标 , 同时提高护甲穿透 %d 点。

items.source: The target has been crushed, pinning it and reducing defense and armour by %d.
items.target: 目标被碾压，处于定身状态，护甲和闪避下降 %d。

items.source: This unit is outside of the starscape and cannot be harmed from within it,
items.target: 该单位处于星界外，不能被星界内单位伤害。

items.source: The target is surrounded by a crackling web of lightning, reducing all damage taken by %d.
items.target: 目标被闪电之网覆盖，减少所受到的所有伤害 %d 。

items.source: Engaged in automated repairs, preventing any action but increasing life regen by %d, all resistances by %d%% and preventing death until falling below -%d life.
items.target: 进入自动修复模式，无法行动，但生命恢复速率增加 %d ，所有抗性提升 %d%%，死亡生命下限为 -%d 。

items.source: Direct control by the pilot increases damage by %d%% and resistances by %d%%.
items.target: 机械蜘蛛被驾驶员直接控制，增加伤害 %d%%，增加伤害抗性 %d%%。

items.source: The target has been splashed with acid, taking %0.2f acid damage per turn.
items.target: 目标被酸液溅射，每回合受到 %0.2f 酸性伤害。

items.source: The target feels the echoes of all light and dark damage it takes. Light damage slows the target by %0.2f%% per point of damage dealt, up to a maximum of %d%% at %d damage. Dark damage creates an effect at the tile for %d turns which deals %d%% of the damage dealt each turn. It will be refreshed as long as the target continues taking damage from it or another source.
items.target: 目标会感受到其所受光系与暗影伤害的回响。每受到 1 点光系伤害，目标便减速 %0.2f%%，减速上限为 %d%%，在单次受到 %d 点伤害时达到上限。暗影伤害会在目标地格生成一个持续 %d 回合的效果，每回合造成相当于该次暗影伤害 %d%% 的伤害。只要目标继续受到该效果或其他来源的伤害，持续时间就会刷新。

items.source: The target is surrounded by a static shield, increasing all resistances by %d%% and causing attacks against them to trigger a shield attack for %d%% damage as lightning.
items.target: 目标被静电力场包围，增加所有抗性 %d%%，对它们的攻击将会触发 %d%% 闪电护盾伤害的反击。

items.source: The target is surrounded by a toxic cloud or radius %d. Enemies within will suffer %d%% talent failure, %d%% reduced healing, and take %0.2f additional acid damage from melee and ranged attacks.
items.target: 目标被半径为 %d 的瘴气毒云包围。被困在其中的敌人会有 %d%% 的技能失败几率， 降低%d%% 治疗效果，并且在受到近战和远程攻击的时候受到 %0.2f 额外酸性伤害。

items.source: The target has been impregnated with %d developing ritch larvae which are feeding on it%s.  After a %d turn gestation period, each will burst out violently, dealing %0.2f physical and %0.2f fire damage to its host.
items.target: 目标被 %d 个里奇幼虫寄生%s. 在%d回合的发育期结束后，幼虫会从寄主体内钻出，每个幼虫造成 %0.2f 物理和 %0.2f 火焰伤害。

items.source: Next melee or ranged attack that deals more than 8%% of maximum life is reduced by %d%% and triggers a radius %d conal explosion dealing %d%% steamgun damage. %d stacks remaining.
items.target: 下一次受到的近战或远程伤害若大于最大生命值的 8%%，则会降低 %d%% 伤害，并触发一次半径为 %d 的扇形爆炸，造成 %d%% 蒸汽枪伤害。 剩余 %d 层叠加。

items.source: %d corrosive flechettes are embedded in the target. Each melee and ranged attack against them will cause a flechette to burst for %0.2f acid damage
items.target: 目标体内嵌有 %d 枚腐蚀性毒镖。每次受到近战或远程攻击时，其中一枚毒镖都会爆裂，造成 %0.2f 点酸性伤害。

relevant_terms.notes: Embers of Rage 角色资源

items.source: The target is warm from the campfire. Increasing steam regeneration by 6/turn, stun immunity by 30% and stamina regeneration by 4/turn.
items.target: 目标被营火温暖。蒸汽回复 +6 ，震慑免疫 +30% ，体力回复 + 4。

items.source: Fight to the brink of death, can not die before going under -%d life (but life under 0 is not shown) and increases all resistances by %d%%.
items.target: 获得 -%d 生命下限和 %d%% 全体伤害抗性。

items.source: The target is surrounded by a charged shield, absorbing %d/%d damage before it crumbles. While this holds, they will project a bolt of lightning against a random enemy within range 7 each turn for %0.2f lightning damage.
items.target: 目标被充能护盾覆盖，在破碎前可以吸收 %d/%d 伤害。当护盾存在时，他们每回合会朝 7 码范围内的随机敌人发射闪电弹，造成 %0.2f 闪电伤害。

items.source: Hovering in place, gaining %d%% evasion, %d%% movement speed and launching a powerful rocket barrage each turn.
items.target: 目标悬浮在空中，获得 %d%% 躲闪概率， %d%% 移动速度，每回合可以发射强力的火箭弹幕。

items.source: Improves senses, allowing the detection of enemies in radius %d and increasing resistance penetration by %d%%.
items.target: 强化感知，侦测半径 %d 码范围内的所有敌人，增加抗性穿透 %d%%。

items.source: The target is moving while shooting, and will reload %sammo when finished strafing.
items.target: 目标在移动中射击，效果结束后恢复 %s 弹药。
